pages.title: DESCENT
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Race downhill against the clock in DESCENT, a mountain-bike game with Timed Runs and a Free Ride option. Follow the trail through berms, rocky sections, roots, and jumps, carrying speed toward the final sprint. Split times let you compare the run with your personal best.

Use W and S or the arrow controls to pedal and brake, A and D to lean, and Space to pump or jump. R restarts and Esc pauses. Braking before a corner and pumping the downhill sides of rollers can help preserve speed. A crash costs time, but you can get back on the bike and finish the descent.

pages.title: Grid Blast
pages.creator: Gaboo
pages.description:
Fit gem blocks onto an eight-by-eight board in Grid Blast. Complete rows or columns to clear them, then link clears together to build combo multipliers. Special star gems add bonuses when removed, giving you another reason to consider which line a placement will complete.

Tap a piece in the tray to rotate it, drag it onto the board to place it, or drag between tray slots to change the lineup. Use those options to prepare useful shapes and keep room available for later placements.

pages.title: Cat Pancake Diner
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Run a cat-staffed breakfast restaurant in Cat Pancake Diner. Prepare pancakes for hungry customers, keep service moving, and manage the feline workers helping with the diner. As the business grows, you can expand across several locations. The three-dimensional simulation combines serving food with developing the diner and looking after its growing operation.

pages.title: Stack Up
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Join matching colors into longer chains in Stack Up. Click or tap a stack to select it, then connect it to other stacks of the same color. Longer combinations bring higher scores and help you reach the current level's objective.

Your turns are limited, so consider what each connection will leave available for the next move. Work through the goals as the puzzles become more demanding.

pages.title: Apple Worm
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Apple Worm is a puzzle about guiding a worm to apples and then finding a route to the portal. Look at the obstacles in the way and think through the path before making your moves. Each part of the route needs to bring the worm closer to its food and the exit.

pages.title: Food Truck Chef Cooking
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Take charge of the kitchen in Food Truck Chef Cooking and respond to your customers' requests. Prepare the food they ask for and keep track of the orders as you work through the cooking-management activity. Click or tap to interact with the kitchen and carry out the steps needed to serve your customers.

pages.title: Royal Kitchen: The Lost King
pages.creator: Giant Tooth
pages.description:
Help a princess search for her vanished father in Royal Kitchen: The Lost King. A wizard has made the king disappear, leaving her to find a way to save both him and the kingdom. Progress through the journey by gathering resources and using them to remove obstacles.

Click the objects highlighted in green to send the work forward and complete each level's objectives. Time matters, so look over the resource needs and blocked routes before choosing the order of your actions.

pages.title: Disk Rush
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description:
Sort incoming colored disks into the correct zones in Disk Rush. Watch a disk's color and tap the side of the screen that sends it toward the matching destination. Correct sorting keeps the run going and helps you build a higher score.

The disks arrive faster as play continues, leaving less time for each choice. Sending one to the wrong side ends the game, so keep checking the color before tapping.

pages.title: G Wagon City Driver
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description:
Explore city streets and off-road terrain in G Wagon City Driver. The game offers four driving modes, with traffic, pedestrians, fuel management, and police chases to handle along the way. You can adjust the G-Wagon's appearance and performance, with a dog accompanying the drive.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, steer, and brake. Left Shift activates nitro, C changes the camera, and G enables slow motion. Take the vehicle beyond the roads to try the rougher terrain or work on navigating the busier city routes.

pages.title: Juicy Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Run a juice-bar matching board in Juicy Match. Group at least three identical fruits or other matching items to clear them, create juice blends, and work toward the level's requested goal. Chain reactions add bonuses and points when one clear leads into another.

Each level gives you a limited number of turns, so focus on its objective before spending moves elsewhere. Tiki provides guidance as you progress through the fruit-filled puzzles.

pages.title: Chrono Drive
pages.creator: Mateq
pages.description:
Reach the finish without hitting traffic or obstacles in Chrono Drive. The other vehicles and hazards move in sync with your own movement, making the timing of your route part of the puzzle. Judge how your next movement will affect the objects around you before proceeding.

Use WASD or touch input to move. Some maps add an E-key action that changes the flow of time, giving you another way to work through the course.

pages.title: Moto Road Rash 3D 2
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Weave a motorcycle through city traffic in Moto Road Rash 3D 2. Change lanes to find a clear route, avoid nearby vehicles, and tackle the road's riding challenges and stunts. Use WASD or the arrow keys to accelerate, steer, and brake. Your task is to keep control of the bike while picking a safe line through the traffic.

pages.title: Candy Color Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: Funnyplus
pages.description: Candy Color Sort Puzzle asks you to arrange colored balls into matching containers. Select a tube to pick up the balls at its top, then choose a destination with room for them. Balls can move into an empty tube or onto a ball of the same color. Use spare space to separate mixed stacks and bring matching colors together. Fill containers with a single color to finish the arrangement, planning your transfers so the balls you need remain accessible.

pages.title: Math King - Math Skill Game
pages.creator: ChennaiGames Studio Private Limited
pages.description:
Choose arithmetic exercises and solve multiple-choice problems in Math King - Math Skill Game. Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division, then select the correct result from the answers shown below the question. The operations offer levels ranging from basic to advanced.

Exercises include one- and two-digit addition and subtraction, sequential addition, multiplication-table questions, and division with numbers up to three digits. Pick an operation to work on and continue checking your calculations against the available answers.

pages.title: Fun Obby Extreme
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Help Obby cross platforms and reach the goal of each level in Fun Obby Extreme. Explore a three-dimensional city through parkour challenges, improving your progress and unlocking equipment as you go. Check the next landing place before committing to a jump.

Move with WASD, adjust the camera by clicking, and jump with Space. Ctrl runs, F interacts with objects, and Esc opens the menu, giving you the movement and interaction controls needed for the courses.

pages.title: Organize It
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Bring order to cluttered arrangements in Organize It. Each level presents scattered objects that need to be sorted and placed where they belong. Look over the arrangement, work out a tidy solution, and use the mouse or touch controls to organize the scene before moving on to the next puzzle.

pages.title: Kobolm Rescue
pages.creator: Studio Schneeya
pages.description:
Send a rescue crew into dangerous caves in Kobolm Rescue. Find sleeping Kobolms, gather building materials, and help the creatures establish a new home on the beach. You manage the work by selecting a Kobolm and choosing the object it should interact with.

Click an empty area when you want to build, assigning the crew's efforts between rescue, resource collection, and construction. Drag to move the camera and use the mouse wheel to zoom, letting you inspect the cave routes and the growing settlement.

pages.title: Dungeon Master Knight
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Battle through a side-scrolling dungeon in Dungeon Master Knight. Your knight attacks with his sword automatically when he approaches an enemy, leaving you to manage how you engage the opposition and use shield blocks to defend yourself.

Work through the dungeon's different foes by combining those close-range attacks with defensive timing. If the knight falls, a rewarded-video revive option can return him to the action.

pages.title: Super Prison Escape
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Help Jack break out of trap-filled rooms in Super Prison Escape. Move the stickman through a jail full of spikes, guards, mechanisms, elevators, and keys, solving puzzles to find a route forward. Boss encounters must be overcome to open locks and continue the escape.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and jump. The on-screen buttons provide those actions with touch controls as you work through each jailbreak room.

pages.title: Slide Hoops 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Guide a set of rings into the hole in Slide Hoops 3D. Rotate the arrangement so the rings can slide into position, continuing until all of them have reached the opening. Slide on the screen to control the movement and adjust the angle as you work out how to release the remaining rings.

pages.title: Chain Disk 2048
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Bring equally numbered disks together in Chain Disk 2048. Control their movement so matching values collide and combine into new numbered disks, then continue building combinations toward the level's targets. Each stage gives you another number-merging task to complete. Tap to play and look for the matching disks that can be brought into contact.

pages.title: DinoMatch: Mahjong Pairs
pages.creator: Yellow Bird Games
pages.description:
Connect identical tile pairs before the clock expires in DinoMatch: Mahjong Pairs. Clear the entire field to finish the puzzle, looking for matching designs across the layout. Linking tiles that are farther apart earns more stars.

Collect enough stars to receive a reward chest. New tile designs unlock over time, while the level arrangements become more complicated, giving you more to consider when choosing the next pair.

pages.title: Superstar Family Dress Up Game
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description:
Style four family members together in Superstar Family Dress Up Game. Each character has a separate wardrobe of clothing, makeup, and accessories, letting you create coordinated looks or give everyone a different style. Customize details such as eye shape and iris color alongside the outfits.

Add pets, fireworks, or decorative stickers to finish the family scene. Click clothing and appearance options to make changes, then use the in-game Camera button to capture the completed group portrait.

pages.title: Lit Ape NFT Generator
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Build a fictional NFT business in Lit Ape NFT Generator, a satirical idle game. Tap the NFT cards to collect in-game cash, then invest it in upgrades that increase your earnings. Faster tapping helps bring in more cash for the next improvement.

Develop the website, improve the artists' productivity, and upgrade the game's Diskord, Twotter, and video-ad operations. The progression revolves around increasing the cash yield of your virtual NFT brand.

pages.title: Risky Train Crossing
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Time your route over railway tracks in Risky Train Crossing. Move the cowboy forward while watching the trains, finding a clear moment to cross before a passing train reaches his position. The goal is to travel as far as you can without being run over.

Tap to hop ahead and swipe left or right to change direction. Completing tasks earns extra coins, which you can spend on additional characters in the shop.

pages.title: Huggy Love and Rescue
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description:
Solve dungeon puzzles to rescue Kissy Missy in Huggy Love and Rescue. Guide Huggy Wuggy through the platforming sections, inspect each level's clues, and work out how to complete the puzzle before wasting too much time.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and jump. With touch input, the game buttons control those movements. Each completed level brings you farther through the rescue, while slow puzzle-solving can cost you the attempt.

pages.title: Torn Pics Jigsaw Halloween
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Reconstruct Halloween pictures in Torn Pics Jigsaw Halloween. Arrange the torn pieces until they form the original image, checking the edges and picture details to find where each section belongs.

Choose between two modes, each containing 36 levels. Every puzzle has a time limit, so you need to finish the arrangement before the clock expires. Play with the mouse, touchpad, or another pointing control.

pages.title: Join Blocks 2048 Number Puzzle
pages.creator: Amazing Game
pages.description: Join Blocks 2048 Number Puzzle presents a grid where tapping a tile increases its number by one. Use that change to create a connected group of at least three equal numbers, linked horizontally or vertically. Matching groups clear from the board and score points, while the remaining tiles shift and new pieces refill the gaps. Look for a tile whose next value will connect nearby matches, then watch how the resulting changes set up your next move.

pages.title: Stickman Jungle Escape
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Use a jetpack to help a stickman flee through the jungle in Stickman Jungle Escape. His pursuers fire lasers and missiles, so guide his flight away from the attacks while collecting boosters that can help him survive. Tap or click to control the character's movement as you try to continue the escape.

pages.title: Rule Your City
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description:
Confront criminals threatening the neighborhood in Rule Your City. Move through the streets with your weapon and fight the troublemakers attempting to break into homes and steal property. The action combines exploring the urban area with aiming at the opponents you find.

Move with WASD and use the mouse to aim and fire. R reloads, the number keys 1–3 change weapons, Alt crouches, and P pauses the game.

pages.title: Secrets of the Castle - Match 3
pages.creator: AnimaGames
pages.description:
Match crystals to uncover the castle's secrets in Secrets of the Castle - Match 3. Move the pieces into rows of three to clear them, break obstacles, and complete the tasks set for each level. Look at the objective before choosing which part of the board to work on.

The game contains more than 5,000 levels, with different obstacles and bonuses along the way. Use your matches to open up blocked areas and work through the castle-themed puzzles.

pages.title: Jewels Blitz 5
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Explore a Mayan-temple setting through gem puzzles in Jewels Blitz 5. Match at least three gems of the same type to remove them, using their powers to clear jungle obstacles and magical seals. Each completed puzzle moves you farther along the saga map toward more difficult boards.

Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges add goals alongside the main levels. Earn gold and magical items as you continue through the temple adventure.

pages.title: Liquid puzzle sort the color
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Separate the layers of water in Liquid puzzle sort the color until each glass contains just one color. Tap a glass to select its top layer, then choose another glass to pour the liquid into it. Keep rearranging the colors until the mixed layers have been sorted.

The puzzle asks you to consider the order of your transfers, working out which glass should receive the next pour as you complete each arrangement.

pages.title: Steveman Lava World
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help Steveman reach the exit door in Steveman Lava World. Collect red eggs to earn points while making your way through the dangerous environment. Thorns and flying monsters stand in the way, so plan a route that lets you gather the eggs and stay alive. Use WASD or the touch controls to guide Steveman through the level.

pages.title: Snake io war
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Grow a worm in Snake io war by eating food scattered around the arena. Collect power-ups, take on rival worms, and work toward becoming the largest one in the field. Building your size and surviving the encounters both matter as you try to beat the other players' scores. Keep gathering food while looking for useful power-ups.

pages.title: The Smurfs Ocean Cleanup
pages.creator: IMPS
pages.description:
Pull rubbish out of the water in The Smurfs Ocean Cleanup. Gargamel and Azrael have polluted the sea around the Smurf's island, and your job is to help restore it. Left-click to lower the fishing line, then move the mouse to guide it as the collected items come back toward the boat.

Each piece of rubbish earns coins. Spend them on greater strength or a longer line to collect more waste, and watch for treasures and stickers among the objects in the water.

pages.title: Cookie Crush 3
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description:
Join Gingy the gingerbread guide in Cookie Crush 3 and work through more than 700 sweet-themed puzzles. Swap cookies with the mouse or touch controls to make matches of at least three identical pieces and complete the current level's task. Matching four or more can produce boosters to help with the board.

Daily rewards, missions, and a separate daily challenge add further ways to earn coins and boosters as you progress through the levels.

pages.title: Instagirls Valentines Dress Up
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Put together a Valentine's look in Instagirls Valentines Dress Up, then take a selfie to earn in-game likes. Choose clothing from the wardrobe and try combinations suited to the date. Completing hashtag goals gives you additional likes to spend.

Use those likes to purchase more clothes, expanding the options for your next outfit and photo. The progression connects your styling choices with building a larger wardrobe.

pages.title: My Virtual Pet Shop
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
Manage a pet-care business in My Virtual Pet Shop. Cats and dogs arrive with their owners, and you need to look after the animals by feeding, washing, grooming, dressing, and playing with them. Keep their happiness up while developing the shop.

Click or tap to work through the care activities as clients check in. The game combines tending to the pets with growing the animal-care business around them.

pages.title: Christmas Memory Matching
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Christmas Memory Matching challenges you to uncover matching pairs of festive pictures before time runs out. Tap two hidden tiles to reveal them, remembering their positions when you find different pictures. Match pairs to remove them and work through the board. There are 30 levels, including stages with shorter time limits, so use what you have already seen to make more accurate selections.

pages.title: Stick Archery
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
Aim arrows at rival archers in Stick Archery and eliminate them before they stop you. Accurate headshots can take an enemy out completely, making the point where your arrow lands important to the fight.

On a computer, use the mouse to aim and click to shoot. With touch controls, drag to set your aim and release to fire, adjusting the next shot as you line up the opponent.

pages.title: Running Around
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Help Bob Miner keep going around a red circular route in Running Around. He is trying to continue his diamond-mining journey, but obstacles and traps block the loop he is running on. Use the mouse or touch input to help him dodge the hazards as his speed increases. Keep reacting to the route ahead to continue the run.

pages.title: Granny Hidden Skull Shadows
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Search six scenes for concealed skull silhouettes in Granny Hidden Skull Shadows. Examine the darker details carefully, then click or tap a skull-shaped shadow when you find it. Correct selections earn points as you uncover the hidden objects. Work through the scenes by spotting the skull outlines among the surrounding shapes and scenery.

pages.title: Disk.io
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Throw a disk at the opponent's defenses in Disk.io. Break through the protection in front of the rival and keep returning the disk during the exchange. An immediate return activates a special throw, rewarding a quick response when the disk comes back. Use the mouse to control the disc battle and work on the timing of your returns.

pages.title: Word Holiday
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Swipe letters together to make words in Word Holiday. Use the resulting words to fill the empty spaces across and down the crossword board, continuing until the puzzle is complete. Check the available letters against the gaps in the grid to work out which words are still missing as you solve the board.

pages.title: Extreme Ninja Fight Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Match hidden pictures in Extreme Ninja Fight Memory. Click or tap two tiles to reveal their images and look for identical pairs. Remember the positions you have already uncovered so you can finish with fewer unnecessary selections.

The game has four levels to complete. Find every matching pair on a board to finish it, then continue through the remaining memory challenges.

pages.title: Cute Pigs Paint Box
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Create your own pictures in Cute Pigs Paint Box, a Peppa-themed drawing activity. Use the on-screen drawing tools to work on the picture and explore the app's extra effects. Click with the mouse or tap the screen to interact with the tools as you build your own drawing.

pages.title: Abandoned City Escape
pages.creator: playit-online
pages.description: Find a way out of an empty, unexplained city in Abandoned City Escape. You wake up alone and need to inspect your surroundings to discover a route to safety. Look around the city and use the mouse to collect items you find. The escape depends on exploring what has been left behind and working out where to go next.

pages.title: Race Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Reassemble racing-car pictures in Race Cars Puzzle. Choose from six images, then select a layout with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Each difficulty setting splits the chosen car picture into a different number of sections to put back together.

Use the mouse to position the pieces, comparing the car's details and the surrounding image as you rebuild the complete scene.

pages.title: Bike Stunt Race Master 3d Racing
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Ride through twisting stunt courses in Bike Stunt Race Master 3d Racing. Keep the motorcycle on the zigzag route and negotiate the track's stunt sections as you work toward completing each level. The stages are timed, so you need to balance making progress quickly with keeping control through the harder parts of the course.

pages.title: Arkadium's Block Champ
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description:
Fill rows and columns on a ten-by-ten board in Arkadium's Block Champ. Arrange the blocks to complete lines, remove pieces, and earn points, looking for placements that clear several lines together to increase your score multiplier.

Frozen tiles need their line cleared twice before they disappear. Lightning tiles offer another way to free space: collecting two in the same line clears it immediately. Plan around those special pieces as you build lines and preserve room for the remaining blocks.

pages.title: Surviving the Zombies
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Feed hungry zombies in Surviving the Zombies. Food drops from the sky, and your task is to control the zombies so they catch the falling brains. Use the mouse or touch controls to react to the drops and help the town's unusual residents gather something to eat.

pages.title: Bike Mania
pages.creator: AceViral.com LTD
pages.description: Bike Mania is a motorcycle trials game about reaching the end of an obstacle course while keeping your rider balanced. Use the arrow keys to control the bike's movement and lean it as the wheels climb over uneven ground. Adjust your pace and balance together to get through awkward sections without crashing. The game tracks your course time, giving you a reason to return to a completed route and work on a smoother, faster ride.

pages.title: Go Slow
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Control the pace of a rising circle in Go Slow. Slow it down to keep clear of blocks moving across its path at different speeds and in different directions. The challenge is to choose when to wait and when to continue upward, timing your movement around each hazard. Use the mouse or touch controls to guide the circle.

pages.title: Geometry Dash Nemesis
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description:
Arm the square character and shoot barriers in Geometry Dash Nemesis. Hitting obstacles with the gun earns gold, which you can use to improve the weapon. Stronger firepower helps you deal with the obstacles standing in the character's way.

Play with the mouse or touch controls, continuing the cycle of shooting targets, collecting gold, and upgrading the gun as you work through the action.

pages.title: Vovan Running
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Keep running through an obstacle-filled course in Vovan Running. Jump past the barriers in your route and react to the next hazard as the endless run continues. Use the mouse or touch controls to manage the action, working on the timing needed to keep the character moving through the course.

pages.title: Gunslinger Duel
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Wait for the signal, then fire before your opponent in Gunslinger Duel. The Wild West contest rewards a quick response, but shooting before the prompt costs you the chance to win the exchange. Watch for the instruction and react with a left click or tap. Surviving the duel depends on both waiting and firing at the right moment.

pages.title: Zombie Shooter Game
pages.creator: Pixellicious
pages.description: Help a ranger fight his way past zombies in Zombie Shooter Game. Move through the platforming action and keep shooting the undead blocking the route. The task combines running through the stages with dealing with the enemies along the way. Use the on-screen buttons to control the ranger and continue the fight.

pages.title: School Bus Driving Simulator 2019
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Pick up children near their homes and take them to school in School Bus Driving Simulator 2019. Guide the bus through road traffic while carrying out the school journey, keeping control of the vehicle as you travel between the pickup and destination. Use WASD to drive and work through the bus-transport task.

pages.title: Orbit Plane
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Defend a planet from waves of ball-shaped attackers in Orbit Plane. Shoot the incoming threats to protect the people below and continue holding off each wave. Use the mouse controls to manage the defense as more attackers arrive.

pages.title: Brain Training
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Brain Training tests how well you remember the positions of hidden orange kittens. At the start of a level, study the blocks that reveal the cats. Once every block turns black, use the mouse to choose the places where the kittens appeared. Take in the whole arrangement before it disappears, then work from memory to identify the correct blocks.

pages.title: Jewel And Crazy Birds
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Jewel And Crazy Birds is a removal puzzle about helping a bird return to its nest. Click or tap the jewel obstacles to break them and open a way for the bird. Look at the arrangement before removing pieces and think about how each change will help the bird reach home. Work through 30 levels of jewel obstacles and nesting challenges.

pages.title: Rabbit Zombie Defense
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Rabbit Zombie Defense puts you in charge of a base threatened by rabbits transformed into zombies. Hold the defensive line and stop the approaching enemies with an unusual arsenal that includes carrots, bananas, tennis balls, and explosives. The game offers seven weapons and five zombie types, giving you different threats to handle as the attack continues. An interactive tutorial explains the basics, while the shop lets you unlock weapons and improve the ones you use. Keep the base protected for as long as you can.

pages.title: Little Cat Doctor
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Little Cat Doctor is a veterinary care game set in a pet hospital. Take the role of a cat doctor and help the feline patients through their treatment and surgery activities. Use the mouse to interact with the clinic and follow the care tasks presented on screen as you look after the cats.

pages.title: Tripoly
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Tripoly is a color matching reflex game built around a rotating triangle. Turn it so the appropriate colored side matches the incoming line, then prepare for the next color. An interactive tutorial introduces the task before the pace becomes more demanding. Keep watching the approaching lines and adjusting the triangle to build a higher score.

pages.title: Line Puzzle Game
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Line Puzzle Game asks you to trace the connections in a network of dots without using an edge twice. Choose a starting point, then use the mouse to follow the marked links from one node to the next. Each new segment must continue from the end of your existing route, and arrows on a connection restrict the direction you can take. Cover all the links to complete the puzzle. If your path leaves you stuck, undo a segment or reset the board and try a different route.

pages.title: Basketball Legend
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Basketball Legend lets you practice basketball shots before taking on a computer opponent. Swipe to send the ball toward the hoop and use the training mode to get a feel for your shots with help from the coach. When you are ready, switch to competition and try to score more baskets than the AI. A tutorial introduces the swipe controls, and the pixel art gives both practice and competition a compact arcade style.

pages.title: Sniper Clash 3D
pages.creator: Freeway Interactive
pages.description: Sniper Clash 3D sends a secret agent into a desert mission to seize a trophy relic from hostile nomads. Move through the 3D battlefield, line up your shots, and use the scope to take aim at enemies. WASD controls movement, Space makes the agent jump, and C lets you crouch. Use the right mouse button to zoom, and press Tab to view the score table. Find positions that give you a clear shot as you work toward the mission objective.

pages.title: Princess Easter hurly burly
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Princess Easter hurly burly lets you prepare Ariel and Rapunzel for an Easter celebration. Choose bunny inspired outfits from a wardrobe of soft colored overalls, dresses, and jeans, then add rabbit hats and baskets of Easter eggs. Complete their spring looks with makeup in shades such as pink, blue, lemon, and white. Use the mouse or touchpad to explore the clothing and cosmetics and put together a festive style for each princess.

pages.title: Space War
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Space War is a 3D spacecraft shooting game in which you chase enemy ships and bring them down. Use WASD to move your spacecraft and change your approach as you pursue targets. Fire with the left mouse button when an enemy is in your sights. Higher levels add more enemies, so keeping track of their positions becomes an increasing part of the challenge.

pages.title: Lambo Drifter
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Lambo Drifter is a 3D driving game focused on keeping your car sliding through drifts. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer and press Space to brake as you work on your cornering. Drifting helps you level up and unlock additional tracks, cars, and achievements. Keep improving your runs to build stronger records and explore the driving options unlocked through your progress.

pages.title: EG Fast Driver
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Fast Driver challenges you to steer a racing car through traffic without exhausting your allowance of three collisions. Click or touch to move left and right, choosing a clear path between the other cars. The game gradually speeds up, giving you less time to react to the traffic ahead. Watch for openings and keep making controlled lane changes to extend your run.

pages.title: Sea Diamonds Challenge
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Sea Diamonds Challenge is a timed puzzle about clearing groups of matching diamonds. Click or tap a cluster of at least three diamonds of the same color to remove it, and search for larger groups as more gems appear. Build the highest score you can before the timer runs out. Clearing diamonds also raises mana for special powers that help remove gems, while clearing the board offers an additional bonus.

pages.title: Death Race
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Death Race is a battle royale driving game built around smashing into rival drivers. Steer with the arrow keys or touch controls and maneuver your car into collisions with the opposition. Keep track of the nearby vehicles as you choose an approach and look for another chance to ram an opponent.

pages.title: Rise Up Space
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Rise Up Space challenges you to shield a research balloon from objects in its path. Move the protector with the mouse and left button or touch controls, using it to keep approaching objects away from the balloon. Stay attentive to the space around it as new obstacles draw near. Points collected during play can be spent in the shop on balloon skins and different protectors.

pages.title: Lost In Dimensions: The Beginning
pages.creator: VGSTudios
pages.description: Lost In Dimensions: The Beginning follows a small creature stranded in an unfamiliar world and trying to return home. Aim a launch by dragging to set its direction and strength, then release to send the creature through the landscape. Land on platforms and plan the next launch as you follow the route between dimensions. Different worlds bring harder stretches of terrain, so missed attempts are a chance to adjust your aim and try another path. Progress depends on judging each launch and being patient with the obstacles ahead.

pages.title: Moto Traffic
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Moto Traffic is a motorcycle driving game about riding through traffic and building a score. Choose from four modes: Time Trial, Traffic Time, Traffic Ride, and Free Ride. The game includes three environments and motorcycle skins for changing the setting and appearance of a ride. Higher speeds earn more points, and riding in wheelie mode doubles the score earned during that move. Pick a mode and balance your pace against the traffic in your way.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Lips Injections
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl Lips Injections is a cosmetic treatment and makeover game starring Dotted Girl. Tap through her fictional clinic appointment, which includes numbing cream and a lip injection sequence, then move on to styling her makeup. Choose a lip liner and lipstick, add colorful eyeshadow, and finish with eyelashes. The game combines a simulated cosmetic appointment with choices for completing her final look.

pages.title: Color Candy
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Color Candy is a timing game about matching a bouncing ball to the colored sections of a ring. Tap or click on the left or right side to turn the ring in quarter turns and bring the matching section into the ball's path. A correct contact adds to your score and keeps the ball bouncing, while a mismatched color ends the run. The ball changes color during play, so watch its current shade and adjust the ring before the next landing.

pages.title: Throw
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Throw is a spear throwing game that tests the timing of your run-up and launch. Start the athlete moving, watch the spear's rising angle, and time the throw to send it as far downfield as possible. Get the spear away before crossing the foul line, since a foul leaves that attempt with no distance score. A round records three throws, giving you several chances to judge the angle and improve your best toss.

pages.title: Orbital Pixel
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Orbital Pixel is a survival arcade game about moving a small pixel between orbits. Change orbits to avoid enemies and collect the items along your route, but keep close enough to an orbit to stay in play. Moving too far away ends the run. Watch the surrounding threats and choose when to move as you try to survive longer and gather more collectibles.

pages.title: Dot Connect
pages.creator: Nilee Games and Future Technologies Pvt. ltd.
pages.description: Dot Connect challenges you to keep a growing grid of colored balls under control. Select a ball that matches the active color to remove it and move your connecting marker to that position. The display previews the next three colors, letting you plan several selections ahead. Successive correct matches build a chain bonus, while choosing the wrong color breaks that bonus. New balls keep arriving, so combine careful color choices with quick decisions to stop the grid from filling up.

pages.title: Water Blast
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Water Blast is a chain reaction puzzle with 400 levels. Burst elements to set off further bursts, aiming to remove every element from the board and unlock the next stage. Study the arrangement and choose where to begin so the reaction reaches the remaining pieces. Each level also offers stars, with faster completion helping you collect more of them.

pages.title: Hexagon Fall
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Hexagon Fall asks you to lower a hexagon down a tower by removing the blocks beneath it. Tap blocks to destroy them and let the shape descend, paying attention to how each removal changes its support. Keep the hexagon on the tower as it moves downward, because letting it fall off ends the game. Choose blocks carefully to maintain a steady descent.

pages.title: Spinoider
pages.creator: MDV Games
pages.description: Spinoider is a survival arcade game about avoiding red obstacles and building the highest score you can. You have ten lives, and the action gradually speeds up, making precise timing more demanding as a run continues. Single player mode gives you a way to practice your reactions. The game also includes an online multiplayer option designed for real time play with friends or other players. In either format, focus on the approaching obstacles and try to keep going as long as possible.

pages.title: Who What Wear - Princess Fall Fashion Tr
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Who What Wear - Princess Fall Fashion Trends helps Jasmine prepare for her first autumn. Begin by finding the items on her list, then use the seasonal wardrobe to create three different looks. Explore coats, gloves, tunics, and sweaters as you introduce her to clothes suited to cooler weather. Combine the pieces into autumn outfits and help Jasmine discover styles she has not needed in her warm homeland.

pages.title: Flight Sim
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Flight Sim puts you in charge of guiding aircraft to their landing zones. Keep track of the planes in the sky and direct them safely toward their destinations. Work through the levels while keeping the airspace safe, aiming to earn a high score through successful landings.

pages.title: knight jump
pages.creator: G.Indi
pages.description: Climb as high as you can in knight jump, an arcade game about a knight making a fast ascent while avoiding fire. Keep moving upward and time your jumps around the danger in your path. Speed matters as you climb, and each attempt gives you another chance to reach a greater height and improve your score.
